title: quercus gambelii var. novomexicana
intro: Quercus gambelii var. novomexicana, commonly known as Gambel oak or New Mexico white oak, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including treating fever, sore throats, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gambel oak include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Quercus gambelii var. novomexicana include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
